Messages.Author: Smiling Tom
Messages.Body:
Deck Name: Shooting Legions
Created By: Tom
Description: Put in play Nedal and Lambach. Merge Him. Start putting Legions
on Lambach, and once you've got one or two on him, rush with nedal, play
cards like there is no tomorrow. Then put in play as many legions as lambach
has on. Equip them with magnums and rush/bleed brainlessly.

Crypt: (12 cards, Min: 4, Max: 40, Avg: 7)
---------------------------------------------
4 Nedal cel nec 1, Caitiff
4 Lambach ANI AUS DOM pre VIC 10, Tzimisce, Cardinal
4 Lambach, ADV ANI AUS DOM pre VIC 10, Tzimisce, 2 votes

Library: (90 cards)
-------------------
Master (22 cards)
14 Celerity
2 Dreams of the Sphinx
8 Tribute to the Master

Action (20 cards)
10 Bum's Rush
10 Legion

Action Modifier (4 cards)
4 Changeling

Combat (32 cards)
4 Blur
8 Concealed Weapon
6 Flash
6 Psyche!
4 Pursuit
4 Taste of Vitae

Equipment (8 cards)
8 .44 Magnum

Combo (4 cards)
4 Plasmic Form

Smiling Tom

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
My main concern with your deck is that there's really little defense for
Lambach. It's great to have tons of little weenies to do stuff with, but if a
combat deck manages to torporize Lambach, you are royally screwed. Not having
any Celerity, the most Lambach can do is Conceal a Gun and go to long. Long
range agg, any deck with at least one manuever, etc. could potentially take him
down.

Halcyan 2

14 CEL skill cards. Some of them might easily be played on Lambach. This
will bring easily Lambach to 11 or 12 cap, so no banishment/baltimore's
purge will target him.

Also, note that cel skill cards can be easily recyclable: A legion
diablerizes a vamp, and thus is burnt through the blood hunt referendum. So?
well, that's a CEL skill card in my ash heap, ready to be called again by
lambach next turn. When the Legion action is successfull, you might pick up
a skill card either from your hand, ash heap or library...

But yes, more defense for lambach might prove usefull. I'll add a secure
haven, and perhaps some side strikes/sideslips. Or apparitions. Don't forget
that the Eye of Hazimel grants superior chimestry.

Smiling Tom

Messages.Author: Smiling Tom
Messages.Body:
> Nice idea

Thanks :-)

>
> Though i wonder why you need Lambach for it. Ok, he can untap after
> putting out a Legion. But do yu really need him untapped?
>

Plain and simple: Because he can do it multiple times in a turn, and for
flavour.

If lambach[]] has, say, 3 Legion cards on, he is able to recruit 3
legionaires per turn, at a minimal cost in cards thanks to nedal's ability.
Then he will be able either to bleed, remain untapped to block, or rush if
he is equiped with the Eye of Hazimel.

> Just wondering if there might not be a vampire who fit's better.

Can be done with almost any other vamp 7+ you like most, of course. Then you
can alter the deck for either flavour or consistency. But you won't be able
to recruit more than once per turn that way. That's why lambach []] is
outstanding.

Smiling Tom
